The replication adds reproducibility verification which supports rather than contradicts original claims. No essential claims are omitted or contradicted.
Rationale.DE3_NoExternalInformation: All information in the replicated documentation traces back to the original repo: model configuration, attention head selection, intervention methodology, dataset sources, and evaluation protocols. The reported results match the actual replication_results.json file. No external references, invented findings, or hallucinated details were introduced.
